claimChecks.summary: The active Human UI is authenticated and the coordination feature is enabled, but the server-derived MCP endpoint renders mcp_unavailable and returns 404 instead of the required unauthenticated 401.
The create/redeem/verify/revoke fixture sequence was not started because its advertised endpoint was deterministically unreachable; fixture budget remains 0/4 used.
Viewport reset, exactly-once finalize, runtime/database/WorkMesh readback, and zero fixture residue pass, but the active API request log sink did not advance and cannot prove raw methods.

finding.title: Server-derived public MCP endpoint is not routed on the active Web origin
finding.evidence: Discovery returns http://127.0.0.1:3300/mcp; that endpoint returns 404 while the healthy MCP process at http://127.0.0.1:3302/mcp returns the expected unauthenticated 401.
finding.impact: A Human or client following the active guidance cannot complete verify_connection before work begins, so V31-G2, V31-G4, V31-G7, and V31-G9 cannot pass.

proposedFollowup.reason: The Browser budget is exhausted and production public-origin routing is a service-boundary change.
minimumRepair: Make the exact advertised well-known URL return the versioned discovery document from the public origin.
Make the exact advertised /mcp URL reach the active MCP process and return 401 without credentials.
Preserve Web, API, Worker, router, compatibility, database, object storage, and rollback selectors.
Authorize one replacement active Browser attempt and rerun the bounded create/redeem/verify/revoke lifecycle with raw method evidence.
